name: crystalaid
description: CrystalAid - Discord Bot + Activity + Backend + Realtime Gamification Ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/types && npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/config && npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/database
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/activity && npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/api && npm run build --workspace=@crystalaid/bot
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
